emma_support: FYI customer hitting intermittent 401s on /v1/generate. They say the UI shows no request id and they can't repro consistently. Asked them to gather a few things so we can correlate.

kai_engineer: Thanks — top-level ask: we need a reproducible request (curl or HAR) or the exact client time window so we can match ingress logs. If they have it, the header we prefer is `Request-Ref` (sometimes `x-rd-request` in older SDKs). If it's absent, SDK debug logs will usually include `requestRef` fields.

emma_support: Copying the steps I'm going to share with them: short and actionable.

emma_support: In the Redwood Console: Console -> Requests (left nav) -> filter by project/org and time range -> click the failed request row -> look at the "Headers" panel on the right. The Request-Ref shows as either `Request-Ref` or `x-rd-request`. Screenshot that panel or copy the header value.

marta_sre: If they can't access the Console, ask for the raw response headers from their client/dev tools. For web/mobile: capture a HAR from the browser or device proxy and send that. For server apps: a `curl -v` is enough.

emma_support: Example curl to ask for (tell them to redact the token before sending):

```bash
curl -v \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"hello"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
\nTell them to paste the `Request-Ref` header value from the response (or the full `-v` output). If the response body contains an error JSON, include that too.

kai_engineer: HAR tips: in Chrome/Edge devtools -> Network tab -> reproduce the failure -> right-click any request to api.redwood.ai -> Save all as HAR with content. Ask them to keep the HAR unmodified (we only need to redact keys, do not truncate the entries). Also ask them to note their local clock time for the failure (e.g., 2026-03-17 14:12 UTC) and their public IP if possible.

tracebot: automated: if `Request-Ref` is missing we can attempt correlation via timestamp + client IP + route, but that reduces confidence — please include as many correlators as possible.

marta_sre: Quick checklist to send to customer: 1) HAR or `curl -v` output (full headers + body) 2) SDK log snippet showing `requestRef` or `request_ref` if available 3) Console screenshot showing header panel (if they can access) 4) Approximate timestamp (UTC) + region/cluster (if known) 5) Note of whether this is behind a proxy/CDN and the public IP. Remind: redact API keys before posting in public threads; upload via the support portal or use secure attachments.

emma_support: I'll paste this into the ticket now and ask them for the HAR + a screenshot. Thanks y'all :pray:
